Sections.Title: Principles of Accounting I
Sections.Comments: WENZHOU-KEAN STUDENTS ONLY. Business sophomores ONLY.
Sections.CourseDescription: This course is an introduction to accounting concepts and principles used in the preparation of financial reports for proprietorships, partnerships, and corporations. The generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP) that are used in this process will be explained and incorporated into all of the instruction. It involves the application of the techniques of using debits and credits, the preparation and analysis of the trial balances (both unadjusted and adjusted), making adjusting entries and assessing the effectiveness of the internal control system of an entity. The student will continuously be exposed to the preparation and analysis of the basic financial statements showing students how to evaluate an entity's performance, and how outside parties use financial statements to make various decisions on those statements.

Sections.Title: Intermediate Acct I
Sections.Comments: WENZHOU-KEAN STUDENTS ONLY. ACCT juniors only.
Sections.CourseDescription: This course involves the role of accounting as an information system and introduced the balance sheet accounts as economic resources. The course analyzes various balance sheet and income statement accounts and includes preparation of financial statements for internal as well as external reporting.

Sections.Title: Federal Income Taxes I
Sections.Comments: WENZHOU-KEAN STUDENTS ONLY. ACCT juniors only.
Sections.CourseDescription: This course will cover: computing federal income taxes and determining and utilizing allowable credits, computing the overall tax result for a sole proprietorship business, determining the Alternative Minimum Tax for individuals, discussing and computing the various tax options related to property (including the computation of the adjusted cost bases and resulting gains and losses at the time of sale or other disposition), and special rules related to home ownership.

Sections.Title: Cost Accounting
Sections.Comments: WENZHOU-KEAN STUDENTS ONLY. ACCT seniors only.
Sections.CourseDescription: Cost accounting introduces students to powerful tools and techniques used by accountants to determine the cost of providing a service as well as generating performance reports for management to perform their functions of planning, controlling and decision making. Students will develop an effective cost accounting system that provides information that is used for various purposes in different types of business entities. This course will place emphasis on developing various budgets, determining the cost of products and services, performing variance analysis, preparing performance reports and managing costs.
